name: 噪鵑
illustrationTaxon: Eudynamys scolopaceus, male main image and one explicitly labelled female close-up; Hong Kong chinensis group

similarSpecies.distinction: 粗厚黑喙、深褐眼；噪鵑成鳥為淡色喙及紅眼，體形也較修長。
較小且細長，黑色細喙，尾端平或略凹，尾下有白斑；不同於雄噪鵑的粗淡色喙。

featureNotes: 雄鳥具藍黑光澤的羽色
雌鳥褐底白斑、淡色腹面帶褐色斑紋

rangeMap.note: Generalized native-range country overview based on south/southeast Asia and China, south to Sumatra/Java/Borneo/Philippines. Indonesia shading does not imply occurrence on Sulawesi or farther east, whose koels are separate taxa; China shading is not whole-country occurrence. Not an occurrence polygon or breeding/wintering map. Small territories may be invisible at 1:110m.

sources.use: Adult male blue-black, crimson iris, large bill, long tail; female spotted upperparts and barred/streaked underside; current species range and IUCN LC.
Large-billed Crow thick arching black bill and dark brown iris.
Square-tailed Drongo-Cuckoo small black bill, square/slightly forked tail, white leggings and undertail bars; dark brown/grey adult iris, not Koel red.
Small slim black cuckoo comparison, curved black bill and white undertail barring.
Runtime scientific name, order and family.
Existing app scores i=2.0, a=3.3, r=4.8, c=3.0, v=4.0, overall=3.4; app indices, not academic ratings.

notes: Female close-up is the same species, explicitly labelled 雌鳥, not a third similar species.
The generated Drongo-Cuckoo iris was corrected from red to dark brown after source review.
